productionFindings: Initial whole-case digest is captured before the first asynchronous authorizeCase callback; evidence-reference digest is captured before source/operation callbacks.

The same two case ACL, evidence and scenario-operation verification passes remain. The second pass validates the observed initial case and is accepted only if the final complete C08 case equals that observation.
The former second cases read is moved after all external callbacks and checkedAt; no third cases read is added. The final read reauthorizes the namespace through the real state provider.

Final case, initial retained case and evidence refs are checked by full digest; source abort suppresses the projection. Returned case/events are built from final C08 data and no external product callback follows.
testFindings: Both parameterized tests use real UI admission, state-provider and SQLite CAS; the domain case itself is an explicit empty fixture seed.

Race is armed only after a successful baseline. Port host check1 is admission and check2 is final revalidation; state-provider and fixture ACL/operations invoke ui.revalidate directly, so they do not accidentally fire the hook early.

Membership change increments business version; content-change variant preserves business version while changing objective. Both advance real C08 storage version and retain the same global UI authority.

Real CAS success is asserted outside the port catch. The test also checks stale status and absence of a value, unchanged fixture digest, still-live lease/request and exactly two cases reads for the port.

The pre-fix read observes its second C08 snapshot before final hostCheck2, so both tests would expose its stale successful projection; the full-digest variant additionally discriminates version-only fencing.
typeReview: Contextually typed generic SfProductStatePort.read wrapper forwards the generic reader without casting.
Seeded state result is explicitly narrowed to ok before storageVersion is used; changed transaction returns a boolean consistently.
BusinessContextService unused functions return Promise<never>, assignable to each declared promise result; empty evidence legitimately avoids them.
No new contract, state schema, foreign producer, monetary value, confirmation shortcut or dispatch behavior is introduced.
limits: Static read/diff/hash review only; no product execution, test, typecheck, build or install was run.
This patch addresses createDecisionCasePort.read. It does not establish a final-callback fence for draft or prepareIntentForCase, nor a global atomic observation of all foreign domains.
The empty case has no financial, human-choice, native-session, evidence-source or domain-effect proof. Existing source-specific runtime evidence retains its original SHAs/runs.
